big: A copper miner cannot simply dig more silver because silver's price jumps. Most silver is a by-product. That is one reason silver's supply responds slowly when demand surges.

lines: Why does silver react so much to the economy?

Factories use it, so busy factories raise demand and slowdowns soften it. Most supply is a by-product of copper, lead, zinc or gold, so it cannot be turned up quickly. Green-energy demand is growing. Recycling adds supply when prices are high.
